definitions.explanation: The percentage of times a person or group attended required sessions such as classes, meetings, or events out of the total possible sessions.

examples.japanese: {出席率|しゅっせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
{出席率|しゅっせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{八割|はちわり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえない→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: If your attendance rate falls below 80%, you won't receive credit.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出席率|しゅっせきりつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}される→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧。
examples.english: In this class, attendance rate is also reflected in the grade.

notes:
{出席率|しゅっせきりつ} is the percentage of sessions attended out of the total. Composed of ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧ (attendance) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate/ratio).

USAGE:
Important in Japanese educational and visa contexts. Universities and language schools often set minimum {出席率|しゅっせきりつ} requirements (typically 80%) for receiving course credit. For international students, maintaining sufficient attendance is often a condition for visa renewal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出席率|しゅっせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high attendance rate
- {出席率|しゅっせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low attendance rate
- {出席率|しゅっせきりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to improve one's attendance rate
- {出席率|しゅっせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: attendance rate is insufficient
